title: The deadline engine has no server-side host
impact: Alerts/deadline tracking work only while a browser tab is open; in Postgres mode write-back is gated to SUPER_ADMIN (:2021), so nothing is ever raised.
fix: Server-side sweep job (timer or POST /api/sweep guarded by CRON_SECRET) reusing sweepDeadlines with the same transaction+audit discipline.

title: Pure core is broken by ID generation
impact: Not a pure function of its inputs: Date.now/PRNG ids break replay; Math.random() is not collision-safe on primary keys (P2002 -> 409); base36 ids mis-sort.
fix: Pass an id factory (or crypto.randomUUID()) through the context the engine already receives; keep Date.now() out of src/workflow.

title: Simulated clock and server clock disagree inside one request
impact: Client and server stamp the same rows from two timelines (SLA clock, "raised X minutes ago"); the demo-clock feature silently does nothing in Postgres mode.

title: Two audit stores in demo mode
impact: authService writes login/failed-password/logout rows to a store the Audit Logs page does not read, so sign-in events are the least reliably visible.
fix: One key, one writer: authService should call auditService instead of maintaining its own array.

title: Duplicated clock formatter
impact: formatAuditTimestamp exists twice, character-for-character, with two defaults (new Date() vs getNow()) - the split that produces the L2-03 divergence.
fix: The server should import the shared formatter and pass the clock explicitly.

title: Six core modules cannot be loaded by the server
impact: Extensionless "../types" imports resolve in Vite but fail under Node (ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND) - exactly the sweep chain the L2-01 fix needs.
fix: Rewrite "../types" -> "../types/index.ts" and add a guard test that imports every src/workflow module under Node.

title: Optimistic locking is inconsistent across the write API
impact: Only applicationSpec rejects stale writes (409); the other seven specs write where:{id}, so two officers editing the same row silently lose one edit.

title: State machines: legal, but the guard is value-based not transition-based
impact: saveHandler is a second unguarded write surface over the same rows: Rejected, Superseded, expiryDate, dueDate and escalationLevel stay writable.
fix: A single rule - "fields the engine owns are not writable through the bulk API" - would make the whole class impossible.

title: Dead and unreachable code
impact: Cron sweep/vercel crons unreachable in Docker; randomizeAllNames unwired; happy-dom unused; client HMAC minting and a 4.91%-coverage repository still shipped.

title: Failure modes (mixed)
impact: DB down at boot: app starts anyway, degraded silently; runtime errors/health are good; notifications/escalations dedupe is read-then-write, so duplicates race.

title: The core really is a shared pure module (protect this)
impact: src/workflow imports only ../types and ../utils/dates; demo and Postgres modes cannot drift on transition legality - best property in the repo.

title: The regulated write path is transactional and complete
impact: State change and audit commit in one prisma.$transaction, then broadcast; a lost race returns VERSION_CONFLICT, not a half-written row.

title: Server sessions are not client-decodable
impact: Random token, sha256 lookup, DB-side expiry, httpOnly + SameSite=Lax cookies.

title: Error handling does not leak
impact: Unknown errors map to a generic 500 and are logged server-side; Prisma P2002/P2025 map to 409/404.

title: Clock injection exists at the sweep boundary
impact: sweepDeadlines takes input.now ?? getNow(), so the deadline sweep can be driven by an injected clock.

title: No circular imports: src/workflow has no upward imports
impact: Recorded clean: none found; src/workflow imports nothing from services/, context/, pages/ or components/.

title: The bulk write API records no audit and uses no transaction
impact: 20 of 45 handlers mutate regulated rows with no audit row and no $transaction; the trail exists only because the client POSTs /api/audit in its own words.
fix: Do it as workflowRouter already does: server-side writeAudit inside the same $transaction (server/routes/workflow.ts:83-114).

title: Enum drift is enforced in the DB by nothing
impact: 0 CHECK constraints, 1 FK; targetRole is cast not validated - one such write makes a notification invisible to every persona, with no error anywhere.

title: All timestamps are TEXT, and the audit stamp is a display string
impact: Notification feed: 0 of 5 positions newest-first (column holds relative labels); no audit_logs column orders the trail - 11 of 94 adjacent pairs out of order.

title: Audit is capped and the cap is invisible
impact: audit.read holders get 200 rows by id with no pagination; 210 filler rows posted by an EVC session buried all 76 real rows and no other read path exists.
fix: requirePermission(user,'audit.read') on the POST plus pagination - "one line of the writer's choosing"; severity raised P2 -> P1.

title: Append-only is enforced only in the path that is not running
impact: Running Prisma DB has no immutability trigger, grants UPDATE/DELETE/TRUNCATE and no hash chain, so silent rewriting of history is undetectable (P-50).
fix: Either enforce it in the Prisma migration (same trigger + revokes) or stop shipping the sentence that says it exists.

title: Snapshot loads whole tables, every keystroke-adjacent refresh
impact: Payload is bounded by table size, not entitlement: 5,018,221 B / 1024-1285 ms per superadmin snapshot at ~200x seed, refetched on every SSE broadcast.

title: Idempotency and dedupe are half-enforced
impact: dedupeKey indexed but not unique and findFirst-then-insert: a low-privilege squat makes the genuine Critical/L3 escalation silently never insert (P-40).

title: Login throttling covers password guessing, nothing covers the rest
impact: The 40 data/workflow/admin/file endpoints are unlimited; buckets are process-local (restart resets, P-57); sessions are revoked, never deleted - 113 rows.

title: Migration safety
impact: migrate deploy retries 30x then starts anyway: an unmigrated schema serves 500s while /api/health returns 200; SEED_ON_START every boot; no rollback path.

title: The regulated document endpoint is verify-only: a rejection is answered by recording a verification
impact: A rejection request returns 200 and stores status:Verified with the officer as verifiedBy; /reject 404s and competentAuthority is discarded (P-38, demo path).

title: A negative decision has no server path: the UI writes generically and authors its own audit row
impact: PUT status:Rejected -> 200 while audit_logs stays 70 -> 70; the trail appears only as client-authored wording the server cannot check (P-39).

title: One-way guards block only the incoming value, so every other transition is free and the refused field cannot be stored
impact: verifiedAt -> 403 REGULATED_FIELD "stamped from the authenticated session" while document_items has no verifiedAt column; every other transition stays free.

title: Three write surfaces are declared with permissions: [] - any signed-in user may create and edit queue rows
impact: P-40 items 1, 2 and 5: an EVC_MEMBER created queue rows and PUT an escalation another role raised -> 200 with resolvedAt stamped; out-of-region POST -> 403.

title: evcVisitSpec has no guard at all and accepts a full-row update
impact: A REGIONAL_OFFICER with no evc.report.submit flipped EVC-8805 reportSubmitted both ways; round 13b showed the same wholesale-update shape on undertakings.
fix: Treat L3-14 and L9-07 as one fix, not two (a full-row PUT must not write the fields the client omitted).

title: Orphan audit rows are reachable and were reached: audit_logs.entityId has no FK
impact: After deleting every probe row, 9 audit rows point at entities and users that no longer exist: 4 VERIFY_DOCUMENT on probe ids + 5 lifecycle rows.

title: The advertised correlation IDs are not generated by the server at all
impact: 147 of 148 rows have correlationId NULL (the one non-NULL is a seed row) and only 11 of 148 carry any previousState/newState, yet the AICTE doc claims Done.

title: Applications' stage/status guard can be bypassed by PUT /api/applications
impact: WITHDRAWN: round 4's in-script comment is wrong; at runtime the two-way guard refuses it with 403 (assertUnchanged stage/status/decision/timeline).

title: Snapshot creates memory pressure / leak on the 8 GB host
impact: WITHDRAWN: RSS flat across the 240 s soak and concurrent load, falling below baseline (528.9 -> 518.1 MiB).

title: Snapshot queries need indexes
impact: WITHDRAWN: full index inventory, the reads that filter are Index Scan; any missing-index framing is withdrawn too - recorded as a strength instead.

title: Random id suffix scrambles the latest-200 audit feed
impact: CORRECTED: base36 prefixes strictly monotonic, 0 ids share a millisecond; the real defect is the two id families at the seam (§3.13.3).

title: dueDate/expiryDate ordering is wrong across months
impact: WITHDRAWN AS A LIVE BUG: ISO in all live rows, 0 rank mismatches; survives only as the missing format validation (payload.ts:252,274,275,302).

title: DOC-501 drifted from seed
impact: WITHDRAWN: the seed value is Expired; round 8 confirms 0 differences.

title: Notifications mis-ordered because of day-first display stamps
impact: REPLACED BY A STRONGER FACT: they are mis-ordered because the column holds relative labels; measured over HTTP, 0 of 5 positions right.

title: 45 handlers share a good baseline shape, requireSession on all routers
impact: Uniform asyncHandler + HttpError + validators, requireSession on all four routers, unknown /api/* returns JSON 404 rather than the SPA shell.

title: No raw SQL: the only $queryRaw is SELECT 1, zero *Unsafe calls
impact: Clean (S-16): SQL injection through string fragments is not a live risk.

title: XSS: zero dangerouslySetInnerHTML, innerHTML, document.write or eval
impact: Clean in src/ and server/; assistant output is rendered as React nodes by a hand-rolled formatter.

title: Assistant navigation injection: clean
impact: actionLinks come from the server-side static catalogue, not from model output.

title: Upload safety is strong
impact: Allowlisted content types, size checked at presign and at PUT, bounded raw body, key validated against "..", UUID names, nosniff + no-store.

title: Error leakage: clean
impact: Generic 500 text, stack logged server-side.

title: Indexes match the query patterns (named a strength in Pass C)
impact: Every filter column, sessions.tokenHash, both dedupeKeys and the composite are indexed; the capped audit read is Index Scan Backward on audit_logs_pkey.

title: Broadcast on write is present on every mutation
impact: broadcast([table]) is called on each mutation, so clients stay live.

title: Snapshot has no N+1: 13 parallel queries, not 13 per row
impact: Positive recorded inside L3-06: the nine findMany calls run in parallel.

title: raisedBy is session-stamped, not taken from the request body
impact: The squatting placeholder is stored as the session user, not the "Institution" the body claimed - the only correct part of that create path.

title: Permission scope holds where it is actually written
impact: P-38/P-40: INSTITUTION_ADMIN PUT -> 403 for Rejected and Expired; out-of-region escalation POST -> 403.

title: Seed-vs-database comparator: total field differences 0
impact: After 6 restores the six seeded tables match the seed field-for-field and probe residue is nil; Pass C left no data drift (rounds 8, 13, 13b).
